name: locked_manor
summary: Harrow Manor has stood sealed since the night its master — the collector Edwin Harrow — was carried out and never carried back. His housekeeping order still holds: each deeper room locked, each key hidden one room shy of the door it opens. The caretaker keeps the seals out of loyalty; the heir has finally come to break them. Central task: reach the innermost room, where Harrow kept the one thing he never catalogued. The manor does not care who you are — a locked door needs its key.
